blocks.text: The Asian Games 2026, hosted by Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, officially kick off on Saturday, September 19. Team Philippines’ delegation will be led by flag bearers Aira Villegas and Albert Ian Delos Santos. When and where to watch the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 opening ceremonies When: 6pm JST, 5pm PH time onwards Where: Paloma Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium, Nagoya Where to watch: In the Philippines, the official broadcaster for the Asian Games ONE Sports/ Cignal TV.
